issue_request: FHIR-14829 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution requesting MedicationRequest.status cardinality 1..1 and stating that unknown should be used when the status of the request is not known by the sending or receiving system.

additional_context: MedicationRequest is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, assigned to Pharmacy and marked approved. The current XML StructureDefinition source preserves min 1/max 1 for MedicationRequest.status, and the current MedicationRequest status CodeSystem defines unknown with the expected not-known meaning. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later core decision reversing the cardinality.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active source already satisfies the final Jira request and its unknown-status fallback semantics.
